title: Authentication | OTP 5x Failure | 24 hour Cooldown | IDV Offered | IDV Success | Eligible | Code 67 Crew Delay | Delay 6�9h (7h) | APPR | Basic Aeroplan
description: Customer enters wrong OTP 5 times triggering a 24-hour OTP cooldown. IDV (Persona) is offered immediately. Customer completes IDV successfully (Persona PASS) and is authenticated. The underlying flight was delayed 7 hours (6�<9h band) due to Code 67 (Crew Transport / Hotel / Logistics Delay � Controllable) on a domestic APPR route (YUL?YYZ). Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210). System evaluates claim as ELIGIBLE under APPR Tier 2 ($700 CAD Cash / $840 CAD AC Wallet). Since Aeroplan is linked, chatbot offers both Cash and AC Wallet (+20% bonus). Customer selects Cash (Interac e-Transfer). At payout stage, IDV is SKIPPED because it was already completed during authentication. Validates: (1) 5x OTP failure triggers immediate IDV offer with 24-hour OTP lockout, (2) Persona IDV PASS authenticates user, (3) DDS evaluates Code 67 with 7h delay under APPR Tier 2, (4) Linked Basic Aeroplan profile triggers dual payout offer, (5) IDV at payout is skipped since auth IDV passed, (6) Successful case creation and payment dispatch.
